title: fix: allow Mouse Without Borders pairing across valid Microsoft signer certificates

proposed_comments.body:
### Identify the actual signer-fixture search locations

**Severity:** `low` (non-blocking test diagnostics)

The helper probes curated Windows system executables as well as dependencies in the test-output directory, but its failure message says only "beside" the known signed dependency. Include both search locations and identify that dependency as the certificate comparison baseline, so a failed run points to the fixture sources that were actually examined.

Keep the hard failure and all existing identity, certificate and signature checks unchanged; this is only a diagnostic improvement, not a request to skip this regression.

```suggestion
            Assert.Fail($"No trusted Microsoft-signed peer with a leaf certificate distinct from {knownSignedPath} was found among the Windows system candidates in {Environment.SystemDirectory} or dependencies in {AppContext.BaseDirectory}.");
```

confidence.rationale: Exact helper searches Windows system candidates and test-output DLLs, whereas its failure message mentions only beside the baseline dependency.

proposed_comments.title: Identify the actual signer-fixture search locations
